# Skill Extractor & Playbook Compiler

> Pure client-side WebAssembly compiler for skills.sh playbooks. Unpack GitHub skill repos and npx commands into paste-ready prompts for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, and GitHub Copilot — no terminal required.

## Overview
Skill Extractor lets marketers, copywriters, designers, and developers unpack modular skill packages (from skills.sh, GitHub, and NPX commands) into consolidated prompt playbooks without Node.js, CLI installs, or sending data to a Skill Extractor server.

## Core Capabilities
- **WASM engine**: In-browser fuzzy matching, token estimation, and hashing.
- **Client-side privacy**: Processing stays in the browser sandbox. No Skill Extractor backend.
- **Exporters**: Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md`), Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, standard `.skill.md`.
- **Inputs**: NPX commands, GitHub URLs, local folders, `.zip` drops, and a 55+ curated catalog.
